title: 第23章 归来第24章 机会
content_zh:
杨七是人傀虽能正常与人交谈但保险起见还是不要进入寨子了，将之隐藏在滔滔江水之下是个不错的选择
开春正是万物勃发之时没有兽潮，以人傀筑基初期的实力和不死不灭的特性无需担心袭击
想好便做杨七“噗通”
一声跳入相距寨子十里的水中，距离卡的恰到好处既不会被水司寨筑基修士察觉也不是太远
杨威只需一个念头这位强力帮手便能在一炷香内赶到水司寨
杨威是夜里秘密回到洞府中的，以他隐秘气息的功力如不是特别关注船上也没人发现的了
“老爷你总算回来了！
这才刚打开房门，听到动静的翠翠站在了门口与他撞了个满怀，一个月不见她还是穿着那件杨威买的白衣红裙
“你不会一直在等我吧？
杨威见她憔悴模样脸色苍白好似很多天没休息了一样
“盼星星盼月亮你总算回来了”
翠翠眼眶中闪烁着喜悦的泪光，等待是最难熬的这一个月里，她是吃不好也睡不好的就等着杨威回来
数着手指过日子生怕杨威就此一走了之，所以此刻格外的激动抱的也很紧
杨威能够理解她心中的情绪，关上房门后又安抚翠翠一番后，这才相对而坐了解起情况来
“我不在这一个月里，有发生什么事情，有人过来拜访吗？
杨威问起正事来
“有啊，好多哩，都是来找俺们炼丹的”
“其中那个白慧君就来找过你三次，说是想让你继续替她炼那什么丹，我说你在闭关她就回去了”
翠翠说着很是自豪的样子自家男人岂是谁想见就能见的
杨威知道是那三枚破禁丹起了作用，白慧君才会如此迫切的让他再次出手

“还有呢？
杨威又问
“当然有啊”
翠翠娇嗔道
“人家可是说了等你回来了，一定要找她，她说一定会好好报答你，瞧那骚劲儿估计就要以身相许了……
“说正事！
杨威冷喝道，翠翠这才收起阴阳怪气
“前两天英杰姐回来了，还送了俺们很多好肉，说是让我等你出关了便通知她”
翠翠指着墙角的麻袋说道，杨威灵识一扫发现血肉中竟还藏着些妖兽血核其中一颗更是达到了一阶巅峰，这可是比妖兽肉更为珍贵的东西，许英杰不可能不知道才对
“还有周法管事也来过几次，袁医师也来过一次，还有很多不认识的人……
翠翠想了想后继续说道
毕竟她只在屋里又不出去走动，所了解的情况也只有这些了
白家人那边暂且不急目前也没有继续扩大影响力的想法，就先去许英杰那里看看吧。
与以往不同一大早杨威亲自带着翠翠登门拜访邻居
来开门的是许文树一见到杨威他便露出礼貌微笑邀请两人进入房中
“杨丹师多日不见，修为又有精进了，真是羡煞旁人啊”
许英杰迎面走来，她依旧是短发黑皮中性打扮
许家姐弟屋内布置很是简单甚至于显得有些寒酸了，除了桌椅外便只有两张床了，墙上挂着一些风干的兽肉
杨威将一切看在眼中，内心也是颇有些感慨，这姐弟二人真是朴实
许英杰把打来新鲜妖兽肉全送给了他，就连可以卖掉换钱的妖兽内核都一并送给他当材料，自己却过得这么清贫的生活，别的不说至少姐弟俩是真的懂得感恩

杨威落座后许文树便拿出了珍藏的好茶招待
许英杰坐在杨威的对面，她上身穿着一件无袖马甲，下身则穿着某种坚硬的兽甲围裙
这两者上都遍布着细小的鳞片看样子是某种妖兽外皮制作而成
小臂与小腿上依旧缠着绷带只露出五指，这打扮就如游戏中的格斗家整个看起来很精神
content_en:
Although Yang Qi is a human puppet and can talk to people normally, it is better not to enter the village to be on the safe side. Hiding it under the roaring river is a good choice.
The beginning of spring is when all things flourish. There is no tide of beasts. With the strength and immortality of human puppets in the early stages of foundation building, there is no need to worry about attacks.
When you think about it, do Yang Qi "Plop"
With a sound, he jumped into the water ten miles away from the village. The distance was just right so that it would not be noticed by the foundation-building monks of Shuisizhai. It was not too far.
With just one thought, Yang Wei could reach Shuisizhai with this powerful helper within a stick of incense.
Yang Wei secretly returned to the cave at night. With his secretive aura skills, no one would have noticed unless he paid special attention to the ship.
"Master, you are finally back!
Just then he opened the door, Cuicui, who heard the commotion, stood at the door and bumped into him. After not seeing her for a month, she was still wearing the white dress and red dress that Yang Wei bought.
"You won't be waiting for me forever, will you?
Yang Wei saw her looking haggard and pale, as if she hadn't rested for many days.
"I hope for the stars and the moon that you are finally back."
Tears of joy shone in Cuicui's eyes. Waiting was the most difficult month. She couldn't eat or sleep well, just waiting for Yang Wei to come back.
Counting his fingers, he was afraid that Yang Wei would just walk away, so he was extremely excited at this moment and hugged him tightly.
Yang Wei could understand the emotions in her heart. After closing the door and comforting Cuicui, he sat opposite each other and understood the situation.
"What happened during my absence this month? Did anyone come to visit?
Yang Wei asked about business matters
"Yes, there are many of them, they all come to us to make elixirs."
"One of them, Bai Huijun, came to see you three times and said that he wanted you to continue to refine the elixir for her. I told her that you were in seclusion and she went back."
Cuicui said with a very proud look. How could her man be seen by anyone who wanted to?
Yang Wei knew that the three forbidden pills had an effect, and Bai Huijun was so eager to let him take action again.
"What else?
Yang Wei asked again
"Of course there is"
Cuicuijiao said angrily
"I said that when you come back, you must find her. She said that she will repay you well. Looking at her coquettishness, she will probably give her life to you...
"Speaking of business!
Yang Wei shouted coldly, and then Cuicui put away her strange aura.
"Sister Yingjie came back two days ago and gave us a lot of good meat. She told me to let her know when you get out of quarantine."
Cuicui pointed to the sack in the corner and said, Yang Wei's spiritual sense swept through and found that there were some demon beast blood cores hidden in the flesh and blood, one of which reached the peak of the first level. This is something more precious than the demon beast meat. It is impossible for Xu Yingjie not to know about it.
"Manager Zhou Fa also came here a few times, Dr. Yuan also came once, and there are many people I don't know...
Cuicui thought for a while and then continued.
After all, she only stays in the house and doesn't go out for a walk, so that's all she knows.
The Bai family is not in a hurry and has no idea of continuing to expand its influence. Let's go to Xu Yingjie's place first.
Different from the past, Yang Wei personally took Cuicui to visit his neighbors early in the morning.
The person who opened the door was Xu Wenshu. As soon as he saw Yang Wei, he smiled politely and invited the two of them into the room.
"I haven't seen Alchemist Yang for many days, but his cultivation has improved again. I really envy others."
Xu Yingjie walked towards me. She was still wearing a neutral dress with short hair, dark skin and black skin.
The decoration in the Xu family's house is very simple and even a little shabby. Apart from the table and chairs, there are only two beds, and some dried animal meat is hung on the wall.
Yang Wei saw everything in his eyes and felt quite emotional in his heart. These two siblings are really simple.
Xu Yingjie gave him all the fresh monster meat, and even the monster cores that could be sold for money were given to him as materials. However, he lived such a poor life. If nothing else, at least the siblings really knew how to be grateful.
After Yang Wei sat down, Xu Wenshu took out the treasured tea and served him
Xu Yingjie sat opposite Yang Wei. She wore a sleeveless vest on her upper body and aSome kind of hard animal armor apron
Both of them are covered with tiny scales, which look like they are made from the skin of some kind of monster.
The forearm and calf are still wrapped with bandages and only the five fingers are exposed. This dress is like a fighter in the game. The whole thing looks very energetic.
